items.source: This transaction manager also supports direct DataSource access within a transaction (i.e. plain JDBC code working with the same DataSource). This allows for mixing services which access JPA and services which use plain JDBC (without being aware of JPA)! Application code needs to stick to the same simple Connection lookup pattern as with DataSourceTransactionManager (i.e. DataSourceUtils.getConnection(DataSource) or going through a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy). Note that this requires a vendor-specific JpaDialect to be configured.
items.translation: 此事务管理器还支持在事务内直接访问 DataSource（即使用相同 DataSource 的纯 JDBC 代码）。这允许混合使用访问 JPA 的服务和使用纯 JDBC（无需了解 JPA）的服务！应用程序代码必须遵循与DataSourceTransactionManager相同的简单 Connection 查找模式（即使用DataSourceUtils.getConnection(DataSource)或通过TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy）。请注意，这需要配置特定于供应商的JpaDialect。

items.source: The default implementation checks whether the EntityManagerFactory is a Spring proxy and delegates to EntityManagerFactoryInfo.createNativeEntityManager(Map) if possible which in turns applies JpaVendorAdapter.postProcessEntityManager(EntityManager).
items.translation: 默认实现会检查 EntityManagerFactory 是否为 Spring 代理，如果可能则委托给 EntityManagerFactoryInfo.createNativeEntityManager(Map)，后者进而应用 JpaVendorAdapter.postProcessEntityManager(EntityManager)。

items.source: This transaction manager supports nested transactions via JDBC Savepoints. The "nestedTransactionAllowed" flag defaults to "false", though, as nested transactions will just apply to the JDBC Connection, not to the JPA EntityManager and its cached entity objects and related context. You can manually set the flag to "true" if you want to use nested transactions for JDBC access code which participates in JPA transactions (provided that your JDBC driver supports savepoints). Note that JPA itself does not support nested transactions! Hence, do not expect JPA access code to semantically participate in a nested transaction.
items.translation: 此事务管理器通过 JDBC 保存点支持嵌套事务。然而，"nestedTransactionAllowed" 标志的默认值为 "false"，因为嵌套事务仅适用于 JDBC 连接，而不适用于 JPA EntityManager 及其缓存的实体对象和相关上下文。如果您希望使用嵌套事务来处理参与 JPA 事务的 JDBC 访问代码（前提是您的 JDBC 驱动程序支持保存点），可以手动将该标志设置为 "true"。请注意，JPA 本身不支持嵌套事务！因此，不要期望 JPA 访问代码在语义上参与嵌套事务。

items.source: This is an alternative to a factory-level EntityManager customizer and to a JpaVendorAdapter-level postProcessEntityManager callback, enabling specific customizations of transactional resources.
items.translation: 这是工厂级 `<code>EntityManager` 自定义器的替代方案，也是 `<code>JpaVendorAdapter``-` 级别的 `postProcessEntityManager` 回调的替代方案，从而能够针对事务资源进行特定的自定义。

items.source: This transaction manager is appropriate for applications that use a single JPA EntityManagerFactory for transactional data access. JTA (usually through JtaTransactionManager) is necessary for accessing multiple transactional resources within the same transaction. Note that you need to configure your JPA provider accordingly in order to make it participate in JTA transactions.
items.translation: 此事务管理器适用于使用单个 JPA EntityManagerFactory 进行事务数据访问的应用程序。若要在同一事务中访问多个事务性资源，则必须使用 JTA（通常通过JtaTransactionManager）。请注意，您需要相应地配置 JPA 提供者，以便其参与 JTA 事务。

items.source: Note: To be able to register a DataSource's Connection for plain JDBC code, this instance needs to be aware of the DataSource (setDataSource(DataSource)). The given DataSource should obviously match the one used by the given EntityManagerFactory. This transaction manager will autodetect the DataSource used as the connection factory of the EntityManagerFactory, so you usually don't need to explicitly specify the "dataSource" property.
items.translation: 注意：若要为纯 JDBC 代码注册 DataSource 的连接，此实例需要感知该 DataSource（setDataSource(DataSource)）。给定的 DataSource 显然应与给定 EntityManagerFactory 使用的 DataSource 相匹配。此事务管理器将自动检测作为 EntityManagerFactory 连接工厂所使用的 DataSource，因此通常无需显式指定"dataSource"属性。

items.source: An EntityManagerFactory has to be set to be able to use it.
items.translation: 要使用它，必须设置一个 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source:
Alternatively, specify the persistence unit name of the target EntityManagerFactory.
By default, a default EntityManagerFactory will be retrieved by finding a
single unique bean of type EntityManagerFactory in the containing BeanFactory.
items.translation: 或者，指定目标 EntityManagerFactory 的持久化单元名称。默认情况下，将通过在包含的 BeanFactory 中查找单个类型为 EntityManagerFactory 的唯一 Bean 来获取默认的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source:
This is an alternative to specifying the EntityManagerFactory by direct reference,
resolving it by its persistence unit name instead. If no EntityManagerFactory and
no persistence unit name have been specified, a default EntityManagerFactory will
be retrieved by finding a single unique bean of type EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: 这是通过持久化单元名称解析而非直接引用来指定 EntityManagerFactory 的替代方案。如果未指定 EntityManagerFactory 和持久化单元名称，将通过查找类型为 EntityManagerFactory 的唯一 Bean 来获取默认的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source:
If the EntityManagerFactory uses a known DataSource as its connection factory,
the DataSource will be autodetected: You can still explicitly specify the
DataSource, but you don't need to in this case.
items.translation: 如果 EntityManagerFactory 使用已知的 DataSource 作为其连接工厂，则会自动检测该 DataSource：您仍然可以显式指定 DataSource，但在这种情况下不需要这样做。

items.source:
A transactional JDBC Connection for this DataSource will be provided to
application code accessing this DataSource directly via DataSourceUtils
or JdbcTemplate. The Connection will be taken from the JPA EntityManager.
items.translation: 此数据源的事务性 JDBC 连接将通过 DataSourceUtils 或 JdbcTemplate 提供给直接访问该数据源的应用程序代码。该连接将从 JPA EntityManager 中获取。

items.source:
Note that you need to use a JPA dialect for a specific JPA implementation
to allow for exposing JPA transactions as JDBC transactions.
items.translation: 请注意，您需要使用特定 JPA 实现的 JPA 方言，以便将 JPA 事务暴露为 JDBC 事务。

items.source:
The DataSource specified here should be the target DataSource to manage
transactions for, not a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy. Only data access
code may work with TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy, while the transaction
manager needs to work on the underlying target DataSource. If there's
nevertheless a TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy passed in, it will be
unwrapped to extract its target DataSource.
items.translation: 此处指定的 DataSource 应为用于管理事务的目标 DataSource，而非 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy。只有数据访问代码才能与 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy 交互，而事务管理器需要在底层目标 DataSource 上工作。如果仍然传入 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy，它将被解包以提取其目标 DataSource。

items.source:
If the EntityManagerFactory uses a known JpaDialect, it will be autodetected:
You can still explicitly specify the DataSource, but you don't need to in this case.
items.translation: 如果 EntityManagerFactory 使用已知的 JpaDialect，它将被自动检测：您仍然可以显式指定 DataSource，但在这种情况下不需要。

items.source:
The dialect object can be used to retrieve the underlying JDBC connection
and thus allows for exposing JPA transactions as JDBC transactions.
items.translation: 方言对象可用于获取底层的 JDBC 连接，从而允许将 JPA 事务暴露为 JDBC 事务。

items.source:
The default implementation throws a TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException,
assuming that transaction suspension is generally not supported.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException`，假定事务挂起通常不受支持。

items.source: Return the JDBC DataSource that this instance manages transactions for.
items.translation: 返回该实例管理事务的 JDBC DataSource。

items.source: Return the EntityManagerFactory that this instance should manage transactions for.
items.translation: 返回该实例应管理事务的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.translation: 返回此事务管理器要使用的 JPA 方言。

items.source: Return the name of the persistence unit to manage transactions for, if any.
items.translation: 返回用于管理事务的持久化单元名称（如果有）。

items.source: Obtain the EntityManagerFactory for actual use.
items.translation: 获取用于实际使用的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source:
This implementation returns "true": a JPA commit will properly handle
transactions that have been marked rollback-only at a global level.
items.translation: 此实现返回"true"：JPA 提交将正确处理在整体级别上已标记为仅回滚的事务。

items.source:
Eagerly initialize the JPA dialect, creating a default one
for the specified EntityManagerFactory if none set.
Auto-detect the EntityManagerFactory's DataSource, if any.
items.translation: 急切初始化 JPA 方言，如果未设置则为指定的 EntityManagerFactory 创建一个默认方言。自动检测 EntityManagerFactory 的 DataSource（如果有）。

items.source:
Close the current transaction's EntityManager.
Called after a transaction begin attempt failed.
items.translation:
关闭当前事务的 EntityManager。
在事务开始尝试失败后调用。

items.translation: txObject - 当前事务

items.source: This target resource factory is usually used as resource key for TransactionSynchronizationManager's resource bindings per thread.
items.translation: 此目标资源工厂通常用作线程级资源绑定的资源键，用于 TransactionSynchronizationManager。

items.source: The returned object should contain information about any existing transaction, that is, a transaction that has already started before the current getTransaction call on the transaction manager. Consequently, a doGetTransaction implementation will usually look for an existing transaction and store corresponding state in the returned transaction object.
items.translation: 返回的对象应包含有关任何现有事务的信息，即在当前对事务管理器的 `getTransaction` 调用之前已经启动的事务。因此，`doGetTransaction` 的实现通常会查找现有事务，并将相应的状态存储在返回的事务对象中。

items.source: Called after doCommit and doRollback execution, on any outcome. The default implementation does nothing.
items.translation: 在 `doCommit` 和 `doRollback` 执行后，无论结果如何都会调用。默认实现什么都不做。

items.source: Useful for specifying entries directly, for example via jpaPropertyMap[myKey].
items.translation: 适用于直接指定条目，例如通过 `jpaPropertyMap[myKey]`。

items.source: The default implementation returns false, assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `false`，假设通常不支持参与现有事务。当然鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: A special scenario is a nested transaction without savepoint: If useSavepointForNestedTransaction() returns "false", this method will be called to start a nested transaction when necessary. In such a context, there will be an active transaction: The implementation of this method has to detect this and start an appropriate nested transaction.
items.translation: 特殊场景是指不带保存点的嵌套事务：如果useSavepointForNestedTransaction()返回"false"，则会在必要时调用此方法以启动嵌套事务。在此类上下文中，将存在一个活动事务：此方法的实现必须检测这一点并启动适当的嵌套事务。

items.source:
Can be populated with a String "value" (parsed via PropertiesEditor)
or a "props" element in XML bean definitions.
items.translation: 可以填充为通过 PropertiesEditor 解析的 String“值”，或者在 XML Bean 定义中的“props”元素。

items.source: Can be populated with a "map" or "props" element in XML bean definitions.
items.translation: 可以使用 XML 中的“map”或“props”元素进行填充。

items.source:
The returned object will usually be specific to the concrete transaction
manager implementation, carrying corresponding transaction state in a
modifiable fashion. This object will be passed into the other template
methods (for example, doBegin and doCommit), either directly or as part of a
DefaultTransactionStatus instance.
items.translation: 返回的对象通常针对具体的事务管理器实现，以可修改的方式承载相应的事务状态。该对象将直接作为参数传入其他模板方法（例如 doBegin 和 doCommit），或者作为 DefaultTransactionStatus 实例的一部分传入。

items.source:
The result will be evaluated according to the specified propagation
behavior for the new transaction. An existing transaction might get
suspended (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW), or the new transaction
might participate in the existing one (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRED).
items.translation: 结果将根据新事务指定的传播行为进行评估。现有事务可能会被挂起（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 的情况下），或者新事务可能会参与现有事务（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 的情况下）。

items.source:
This method gets called when the transaction manager has decided to actually
start a new transaction. Either there wasn't any transaction before, or the
previous transaction has been suspended.
items.translation: 此方法在事务管理器决定实际开始一个新事务时被调用。要么之前没有事务，要么之前的交易已被挂起。

items.source:
An implementation does not need to check the "new transaction" flag
or the rollback-only flag; this will already have been handled before.
Usually, a straight commit will be performed on the transaction object
contained in the passed-in status.
items.translation: 实现无需检查“新事务”标志或回滚专用标志；这些在此之前已经处理过。通常，将在传入状态中包含的事务对象上执行直接提交。
实现无需检查“新事务”标志；该标志此前已处理。通常，将对传入状态中包含的事务对象执行直接回滚。

items.source:
The default implementation throws an IllegalTransactionStateException,
assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not
supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `IllegalTransactionStateException`，假定参与现有事务通常不受支持。当然，鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: Should not throw any exceptions but just issue warnings on errors.
items.translation: 不应抛出任何异常，而应在出错时仅发出警告。

items.source: Specify a callback for customizing every EntityManager resource created for a new transaction managed by this JpaTransactionManager.
items.translation: 指定一个回调，用于自定义由该 `<code>JpaTransactionManager` 管理的新事务创建的每个 `<code>EntityManager` 资源。

items.source: Allow Map access to the JPA properties to be passed to the persistence provider, with the option to add or override specific entries.
items.translation: 允许 `Map` 访问传递给持久化提供程序的 JPA 属性，并可选择添加或覆盖特定条目。

items.source: Specify JPA properties, to be passed into EntityManagerFactory.createEntityManager(Map) (if any).
items.translation: 指定要传递给 EntityManagerFactory.createEntityManager(Map) 的 JPA 属性（如有）。

items.source: Specify JPA properties as a Map, to be passed into EntityManagerFactory.createEntityManager(Map) (if any).
items.translation: 将 JPA 属性指定为 Map，并将其传递给 `EntityManagerFactory.createEntityManager(Map)`（如果有）。

items.source:
Check if the given transaction object indicates an existing transaction

items.translation: 检查给定的事务对象是否表示一个已存在的事务（即，一个已经启动的事务）。

items.source:
Retrieves an EntityManagerFactory by persistence unit name, if none set explicitly.

items.translation: 通过持久化单元名称获取 EntityManagerFactory，如果未显式设置。如果没有指定持久化单元，则回退到默认的 EntityManagerFactory bean。
